THE WRITE CLUSTER IS STILL RUNNING AND THE SECTION 5 BULK-EDIT TEST WAS APPLIED AFRESH RATHER THAN INHERITED. The first read pass of this run completed about 16:29 and was immediately invalidated: Northeast Georgia, Healthfirst and Northwest Permanente were written at 16:26:16 and Beamery the company at 16:30:25, i.e. AFTER that pass. The run therefore did not trust its own snapshot - it waited four and a half minutes and re-read both the deal and company sets by hs_lastmodifieddate DESC. The second pass found a further burst at 16:30:37-16:30:38 (Northwest Permanente, Northeast Georgia, Healthfirst, Beamery) and Harri the company at 16:31:49, then nothing: at 16:35 the newest write in the portal was 3m23s old, which is the clear interval section 5 asks for, so the figures are settled rather than mid-write. Every one of those records was then compared field by field against the committed baseline and every tracked field is identical. Northeast Georgia still open at Proposal 42500 with closedate 13 Nov 2026, Healthfirst open at Proposal 13300 closedate 28 Oct 2026, Northwest Permanente open at Proposal 13300 closedate 10 Nov 2026, Beamery still Selling with agreement_in_place true and partner_status Active, Harri still Selling with agreement true and Active. Nothing beyond the stamp was patched, so there was no figure for an unsettled write to corrupt. Future runs should expect this stream to continue and should re-apply the test rather than inheriting this run's conclusion about it.
